Class BrickRotator

java.lang.Object
com.comp2042.game.bricks.BrickRotator
public class BrickRotator extends Object
Manages the rotation logic for bricks. It handles the retrieval of rotation matrices and implements logic to attempt rotations with wall-kick offsets if the standard rotation is blocked.

  • Method Details

    • tryRotate

      public GamePoint tryRotate(int[][] boardMatrix, GamePoint currentOffset)
      Attempts to rotate the current brick. Tries the standard rotation first, then applies wall kicks (shifts) if needed.
      Parameters:
      boardMatrix - The current state of the board grid (for collision checks)
      currentOffset - The current x, y coordinates of the brick
      Returns:
      The new valid GamePoint if rotation succeeded, or null if impossible.

    • getNextShape

      public NextShapeInfo getNextShape()

      Returns:

    • getCurrentShape

      public int[][] getCurrentShape()
      Returns the currently active rotation matrix of the brick.
      Returns:
      a 2D array representing the current rotation of the brick

    • applyRotation

      public void applyRotation(int rotationIndex)
      Applies a rotation by updating the active rotation index. This method does not compute or validate rotation correctness — validation must be handled externally
      Parameters:
      rotationIndex - the index of the rotation to apply

    • setBrick

      public void setBrick(Brick brick)
      Sets the currently active brick and resets its rotation to the default state.
      Parameters:
      brick - the new brick instance to rotate
